{{Quote|By the immortal gods of the Sith!|Darth Vader|<ref name="MSW6" />}}
The '''immortal gods of the Sith''' were a pantheon of [[Deity/Legends|deities]] worshipped by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Vader swore by them during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when his [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|advanced starfighter]] got knocked out of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] trench.<ref name="MSW6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The immortal gods of the Sith were mentioned in the [[Star Wars (1977) 6|sixth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']], which is an adaptation of the original [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']] film. The issue was written by [[Roy Thomas]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="MSW6" /> on [[September 13]], [[1977]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53796/star_wars_1977_6|text=Star Wars (1977) #6}}</ref> The [[2011]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' introduced several deities worshipped by the original [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Ajunta Pall]] was associated with [[Typhojem/Legends|Typhojem]], the Left-Handed God, and the Sith [[King/Legends|kings]]&mdash;also known as [[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]]&mdash;were also viewed as demigods.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Additionally, [[Darth Andeddu]] was also referred to as the "Immortal God-King of Prakith" in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="DOE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>
